data.title: Co-Diagnostics to Hold Press Conference
data.description: Interested parties, including media, analysts, and investors are invited to participate in an event either in person or through a live webcast on September 16 at 10:30 a.m. Eastern Time. The event will take place in Salt Lake City and pertains to Co-Diagnostics, Inc. (Nasdaq: CODX), a molecular diagnostics company known for its innovative patented platform.

data.title: Charter Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend on Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock
data.description: In Stamford, Connecticut on September 15, 2026, Charter Communications, Inc. revealed that its Board of Directors has approved the regular quarterly cash dividend for holders of its Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock. The Company's stock trades on NASDAQ under the tickers CHTR and CHTRP.

data.title: Identiv Completes Sale of IoT Assets and Renames Company INVE Technologies, Inc.
data.description: In a recent development, Identiv, Inc. has rebranded itself as INVE Technologies, Inc. The company is shifting its focus towards establishing a Physical AI Software as a Service (SaaS) business and anticipates bolstering this initiative through a strategic partnership with Trackonomy. Additionally, James Greenwell will take over as the interim CEO starting September 21, 2026. These changes come into effect from September 15, 2026, and mark a significant transformation for the company based in Santa Ana, California.

data.title: Attalon and AeroVironment Execute Long-Term Agreement Supporting Production of Mission-Ready High-Energy Laser Systems
data.description: Philadelphia-based AeroVironment has signed a long-term agreement (LTA) with Attalon for the delivery of Attalon's Valaris high-energy laser platform. The agreement aims to support AeroVironment's LOCUST® and other high-energy laser programs as interest in mission-ready directed energy capabilities increases. The partnership comes in response to the growing demand for deployable directed energy solutions. This collaboration will see the integration of Attalon's advanced laser technology into AeroVironment's product line, enhancing its portfolio of high-energy laser offerings.

data.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. Announces Quarterly Dividend
data.description: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLXS) based in DUBUQUE, Iowa, has reported that its Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend of $0.25 per share. The dividend will be payable on October 12, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 30, 2026. Notably, Flexsteel has continuously paid out cash dividends on its common stock every year since 1938, marking this upcoming dividend as the 339th consecutive quarterly cash dividend. The company, commonly referred to as Flexsteel, is recognized as one of the largest residential furniture manufacturers.

data.title: Danaher Announces Quarterly Dividend
data.description: On September 15, 2026, Danaher Corporation (NYSE: DHR) revealed that its Board of Directors has sanctioned a standard quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 for each share of its common stock. This dividend is slated to be paid out on October 30, 2026, to shareholders recorded on September 30, 2026. This move aims to benefit the holders of Danaher Corporation's common stock.

data.title: Baosheng Media Group Holdings Limited Receives Nasdaq Notice Regarding Minimum Bid Price Deficiency
data.description: Baosheng has been notified by Nasdaq regarding their stock's failure to meet the minimum bid price requirement of $1 per share. They now have until March 9, 2027, to increase the stock price and regain compliance with Nasdaq regulations. Despite this notification, Baosheng's listing on the exchange will remain active during this period.

data.title: BKV Completes Acquisition of Barnett Shale Upstream, Midstream, and Carbon Capture Assets
data.description: In Denver, BKV Corporation (NYSE: BKV) has successfully finalized the purchase of specific Barnett Shale upstream, midstream, and CCS assets. The exact details of the deal remain undisclosed. This acquisition signifies a significant step forward for BKV as it enhances their closed-loop energy approach. By incorporating additional top-notch, low-decline Barnett Shale assets into their portfolio, BKV is intensifying its operational reach and boosting production capacity. These assets align well with the Company’s current operations and infrastructure, paving the way for further growth.

data.title: TechnipFMC Awarded iEPCI® Contract for PETRONAS’ Limbayong Project Offshore Malaysia
data.description: TechnipFMC has shared that its subsidiary, FMC Wellhead Equipment Sdn. Bhd., received a noteworthy(1) integrated Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (iEPCI®) contract from PETRONAS Carigali Sdn. Bhd. for the Limbayong deepwater project in Malaysia. This deal involves utilizing the Subsea 2.0® configure-to-order (CTO) platform and iEPCI® techniques for the subsea scope, aiming to minimize costs and enhance efficiency. The project is set to bring substantial benefits to both companies and the region.

data.title: Uniti Group Inc. to Participate at Upcoming Conferences
data.description: In Arkansas on September 15, 2026, Uniti Group Inc. ("Uniti") made public that its senior leaders will be attending various conferences. The company's participation includes events for investors and industry professionals to be held in the near future. Uniti, listed as Nasdaq: UNIT, aims to engage with audiences at these conferences to discuss their strategies and future plans.

data.title: SiriusPoint Appoints Rachel Winoski as Chief Human Resources Officer
data.description: In Bermuda on September 15, 2026, SiriusPoint Ltd. (NYSE: SPNT), a leading global specialty underwriter, revealed the selection of Rachel Winoski as the new Chief Human Resources Officer. Winoski is set to assume the role on October 5, 2026.

data.title: Worthington Enterprises Announces Investor Day; Renames Business Segments
data.description: On November 10, Worthington Enterprises will be holding an Investor and Analyst Day. At this event, the company will also unveil new names for its two business segments.

data.title: Crown Castle to Present at the 2026 RBC Capital Markets Global Communications Infrastructure Conference
data.description: On September 15, 2026, Crown Castle Inc. (NYSE: CCI) revealed that Sunit Patel, the company's Executive Vice President and CFO, will speak on September 29, 2026, at 10:50 a.m. Eastern Time during the 2026 RBC Capital Markets Global Communications Infrastructure Conference. The presentation, estimated to be around 20 minutes, will be streamed live on the Internet. To access the live audio webcast link and presentation, visit Crown Castle’s website at www.crowncastle.com. The content will also be stored for later replay.

data.title: SPX Technologies Announces Acquisition of FIS Water
data.description: Diversifies Cooling Platform by Introducing Additional Water Management and Control Solutions, providing a wider range of services and products. The expansion comprises a variety of new solutions to effectively manage water, further enhancing the Cooling Platform's capabilities. This move is aimed at enriching the existing offerings by integrating innovative water-related technologies into the platform. The initiative includes incorporating new control solutions, with a range of specialized products being introduced. These additions will significantly bolster the Cooling Platform's portfolio, equipping it to cater to a more diverse set of requirements.

data.title: Asure Expands 2026 Conference Presence to Address $1.7B Enterprise Payroll Tax Opportunity
data.description: The organization will showcase its enterprise payroll tax and treasury solutions at three major conferences in October - Workday Rising, HR Tech, and Oracle AI World. The company will present its innovative offerings in the field of payroll tax and treasury services at these events.

data.title: FTAI Aviation Announces $500 Million Share Repurchase Program
data.description: On September 15, 2026, FTAI Aviation Ltd. (NASDAQ: FTAI) announced the approval of a new Share Repurchase Program by its board of directors. Under this program, the company is authorized to repurchase up to $500 million worth of its outstanding ordinary shares. The Share Repurchase Program is set to conclude by either the completion of the repurchases or September 30, 2029. FTAI plans to finance these repurchases using the cash available on its balance sheet.

data.title: Cronos to Host 2026 Investor Day at its Cronos GrowCo Facility in Kingsville, Ontario
data.description: The Cronos Leadership Team is delighted to announce that registration is officially open for their inaugural Investor Day scheduled for September 24, 2026. Investors are encouraged to secure their spots promptly to participate in this exclusive event.

data.title: Raymond James Financial Announces Key Executive Leadership Appointments
data.description: On September 15, 2026, in St. Petersburg, Florida, Raymond James Financial revealed that Bank Segment President Steve Raney, who managed the company's banking business for 21 years, will shift to an executive consulting position starting January 1, 2027. This move is part of RJF's strategic succession planning. Scott Curtis, the Chief Operating Officer of RJF, will assume leadership of the Bank Segment following Raney's transition. Raymond James Financial trades on the NYSE under the ticker symbol RJF.
